command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='eb10cdd70039e82d09cc03231b52ad851fe42546'; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "${EXPECTED}"; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "${SERIAL}"; echo '--- fatal stack ---'; adb -s "${SERIAL}" logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -A100 -B15 'FATAL EXCEPTION: main' | tail -n 140; echo '--- exit info ---'; adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell dumpsys activity exit-info io.blueeye | head -n 220; echo '--- pid ---'; adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell pidof io.blueeye || true; echo CRASH_CAPTURE_V2=PASS
